- When sentiment is high (≥0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 10–20% for high sentiment periods.
- When sentiment is low (≤0.33), model underestimates; increase forecast by 10–20% for low sentiment periods.
- Model consistently overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., 2.44→2.48→2.45) with exaggerated 30d forecasts; cap forecast at 1.5x recent 7-day high to avoid overshoot.
- If true outcome exceeds 3x recent 7-day high, model is likely overconfident; apply downward correction of 20–40% for such outliers.
- Model underestimates mean-reversion periods (e.g., 2.32→2.29→2.32→2.34) — adjust forecast to align with 20-day moving average if sentiment is neutral.
- For 30d forecasts, if sentiment history shows alternating high/low, model tends to oscillate; smooth forecast with weighted average of 3–5 recent values if sentiment is volatile.
